next.description: Next page link, null if no more items

pageToken.description: An opaque continuation token for this page, null for the first page

nextPageToken.description: An opaque continuation token for the next page, null if no more items

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return for this page. By default, returns 10 entries. The maximum possible number of entries returned is 200.

size.description: The size of the items array for this page
